market_notes: Majors slipped: BTC about $74,300, ETH about $2,116, SOL about $86.90.
Solrouter (ROUTER) main pool printed a new low near $42,600; both pools together about $55,900. Price about $0.000485 (down about 16%). No founder-departure or paying-customer announcement.

Ankr bridge (~$304k), ACryptoS (~$665k, shutdown reported) and Keplr wallet thefts were circulating; they were not yet independently confirmed in the morning note and do not involve the core tracked names. DefiLlama later listed them.
